text: True or False: Four-wave mixing is strongest far from the zero-dispersion wavelength, which is why SMF-28 operating at 1550 nm with 100 GHz channel spacing is severely limited by FWM.
explanation: False. Four-wave mixing is phase-matched and therefore strongest NEAR the zero-dispersion wavelength. Because SMF-28 has substantial dispersion (~17 ps/(nm*km)) at 1550 nm, phase matching is broken and FWM is negligible at 100 GHz spacing.
